summary: Firefox’s font system now uses the Skrifa font engine more broadly for FreeType metrics and glyph lookup, while adding support for more CSS font features and Fangsong and Kai families. Font data is protected more carefully against concurrent access and large color-font palettes now use fallible allocation, reducing the risk of crashes or wasted memory. Hardware video encoding and decoding checks were also tightened, including disabling hardware decoding on Linux when DMABUF is unavailable.
